gaps.title: Cross-service EventBus (typed pub/sub)
gaps.exists: No EventBus exists. Services use direct method calls. Some ad-hoc EventEmitter in gateway-ws.ts (WorkflowEventRelay). IWebSocketRelayService registered in DI.
gaps.missing: New IEventBus interface + TypedEventBus implementation with channel subscription, wildcard support, and DI registration
gaps.risk: LOW — purely additive, no existing code changes

gaps.title: Unified search pipeline (merge Knowledge + Obsidian + external)
gaps.exists: SmartSearch, HybridSearch, VectorSearch exist in search/. HybridSearch has RRF fusion. IKnowledgeService has search(). IEmbeddingService in DI. IObsidianService has search.
gaps.missing: UnifiedSearchPipeline that coordinates all search backends, normalizes results, applies hybrid scoring, and exposes single search interface
deps: A8 (search strategy config drives pipeline routing)
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — must not break existing SmartSearch/HybridSearch/VectorSearch APIs

gaps.title: Delegate broker sub-plan dispatch
gaps.exists: DelegateBroker has full lifecycle (submit/queue/run/complete/cancel). DelegateHandle has message injection. No sub-task decomposition.
gaps.missing: SubPlan decomposer that splits a task into parallel sub-tasks, tracks their individual completion, and aggregates results
gaps.risk: LOW — extending DelegateBroker with new method, no breaking changes

gaps.title: MCP Gateway request routing + provider fallback
gaps.exists: MCPGatewayAdapter in DI. mcp/ directory has gateway implementation. No routing or fallback logic visible.
gaps.missing: RequestRouter that maps tool calls to handlers, ProviderFallbackChain that tries providers in order on failure
deps: A5 (fallback chain reuses circuit breaker state)
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — gateway is external-facing, must maintain API contract

gaps.title: LLM service circuit breaker + cross-provider fallback
gaps.exists: LLMServiceImpl has Map<string,ILLMProvider> + checkBudget(). No circuit breaker. Provider Map exists but no fallback chain.
gaps.missing: CircuitBreaker class (closed→open→half-open states), provider health tracking, automatic fallback on provider failure
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — must not break existing LLM call paths; checkBudget integration

gaps.title: Artifact passing between workflow stages
gaps.exists: state.json tracks artifacts with path/type/milestone/phase. workflow.ts reads state.json. Scratch dirs exist per stage.
gaps.missing: Formal ArtifactContract interface defining input/output schemas per stage, ArtifactResolver that validates and resolves references
gaps.risk: LOW — wrapping existing conventions in typed interfaces

gaps.title: Nowledge Mem P1 bridge (Knowledge ↔ Graph bidirectional sync)
gaps.exists: NowledgeMemServiceAdapter in DI. NowledgeMemKnowledgeBridge exists. DistillationNowledgeBridgeAdapter + ConflictNowledgeBridgeAdapter from Phase 1. GraphEngineAdapter in DI.
gaps.missing: Bidirectional sync: knowledge changes → graph updates, graph queries → knowledge retrieval. Change detection + delta sync.
gaps.risk: MEDIUM — knowledge/graph are core data stores, must not corrupt

gaps.title: SearchService hybrid strategy config (local → semantic → external)
gaps.exists: HybridSearch has strategies[] + RRF config. VectorSearch has embedding service. SmartSearch has basic search.
gaps.missing: StrategyConfig that defines cascade order (local→semantic→external), fallback thresholds, and performance hints. SearchProfile for different use cases.
gaps.risk: LOW — extending HybridSearch config, no breaking changes

execution_order.reason: Foundational: no upstream dependencies, enable downstream gaps
Dependent: build on A1 (EventBus) and A5 (circuit breaker)

key_insights: EventBus (A1) is the keystone — A3, A4, A7 all depend on it
Circuit breaker (A5) is independent but A4's fallback chain needs it
Artifact passing (A6) and Search config (A8) are low-complexity quick wins
All 8 gaps are MEDIUM complexity — no single HIGH complexity blocker
Risk profile is favorable: 4 LOW, 4 MEDIUM, 0 HIGH
